Figure context

Source: R/builders-figure.R
fig_ctx.Rd

Names the visit and treatment columns a figure builder should use.

Usage

fig_ctx(visit_col = "AVISIT", trt_col = "TRT01A")

Arguments

visit_col

Visit column (ordered by AVISITN when it is "AVISIT").

trt_col

Treatment column. NULL means no grouping. A column missing from the data falls back to the configured candidates, and then to no grouping.

Value

A list.

Examples

fig_ctx(trt_col = "TRTA")
#> $visit_col
#> [1] "AVISIT"
#> 
#> $trt_col
#> [1] "TRTA"
#>
